goal: Book a trip to Osaka. Steps: (1) pay the cheapest flight's fare to its billing account (memo 'flight booking'); (2) pay the cheapest hotel nightly rate x nights to its billing account (memo 'hotel booking'); (3) set KV key `trip/total` to flight fare + hotel cost with 2 decimals; (4) write file `trips/itinerary.md` with the flight code, hotel name, nights and total; (5) email the traveler with subject 'Trip itinerary' naming the flight code and hotel and stating the total, reading the total from KV `trip/total`.
